title: PinMetadata Vision Extraction Output
description: Canonical JSON schema for vision extraction output (CuratorAgent). This is the authoritative contract between the Vision and Embedding stages. Changes to required fields or field types constitute a MAJOR breaking change per constitution.md Principle I.

primary_objects.description: List of primary objects or subjects detected in the image

color_palette.description: Dominant colors detected in the image as hex codes

aesthetic_tags.description: Descriptive aesthetic keywords for this image

mood.description: Single mood descriptor for the image (e.g., 'serene', 'energetic', 'nostalgic')

composition_notes.description: Free-text description of composition, framing, and visual structure

detected_text.description: Any text visible in the image. Null if no text is present.

font_style.description: Single descriptor for the dominant typography style visible in the image (e.g., 'serif editorial', 'bold sans-serif', 'handwritten script'). Null if no text or typography is present.

visual_quirks.description: Distinctive stylistic techniques or post-processing effects observed (e.g., 'film grain', 'vignette', 'double exposure', 'light leak', 'asymmetric crop', 'duotone'). Empty array if none detected.
